PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Persistent open-world ocean archipelago PvP character save record for an authenticated player.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

displayName.description: Chosen warrior name visible in the world

tunicColor.description: Hex color for the warrior's cloak and tunic accent

playerClass.description: Selected class (guardian, archer, lancer, bomber, mage, assassin, fishman, yeti)

classWeaponUnlocked.description: Whether the class signature weapon quest has been completed

yetiRuneUnlocked.description: Whether the 5x Yeti Rune from the Lv.1000 North Pole Giant Yeti has been unlocked

desertArenaProgress.description: Highest Desert Arena wave cleared (0 to 5)

hasHorse.description: Whether the player has purchased the mount horse from the Starter Town stable

gold.description: Gold currency earned from PvP, naval raids, and exploration

agilityTier.description: Agility and stamina upgrade tier (1 to 10)

pvpKills.description: Total defeated PvP rivals and challengers

foodInventory.description: Map of owned tavern food IDs to quantities (max 10 keys)

activeShipId.description: Selected active ship ID or empty string

convoyTier.description: Current naval convoy escalation tier (1 to 10)

lastX.description: Last saved world X coordinate (-1900 to 1900)

lastZ.description: Last saved world Z coordinate (-1900 to 1900)

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last cloud save

/users/{userId}.description: Private persistent character save record owned exclusively by the authenticated user.
